Do you enjoy keeping machines running smoothly? 
Then this technical challenge might be the perfect fit for you!

For an international chocolate producer, we’re looking for a maintenance technician to support the production department. You’ll be part of a skilled team ensuring the reliability and efficiency of the machinery through preventive maintenance and troubleshooting. You work closely with fellow technicians, line operators, and supervisors, reporting directly to the technical supervisor.

Your mission: keep everything running like a well-oiled machine — literally.
 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues on machinery and tools.
 - Perform preventive maintenance on equipment and installations.
 - Assist in machine setups and technical interventions.
 - Contribute to technical improvement projects.
 - Maintain order, cleanliness, and safety according to standards.
 - Follow lockout/tagout procedures during maintenance.
 - Manage production-related side streams (waste, recycling, ...).
 - Participate in internal quality and safety training sessions.
 - Carry out and register required quality inspections.

Are you the hands-on technician we’re looking for? 
Apply today – we’d love to meet you!
- Vaardigheden:
You have a technical secondary diploma (A2).
You have at least 3 years of experience in a production environment.
You have solid knowledge of electromechanics.
You work well independently and as part of a team.
You are accurate, quality-driven, and safety-conscious.
You can set priorities and take initiative.
You work hygienically and pay attention to order and cleanliness.
You’re eager to learn and professional in your communication.
You’re willing to work in a nightshift schedule.
Knowledge of pneumatics and cooling systems is a plus.

- Attesten:
No specific certificates required.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
A2 diploma required (preferably electromechanics).

- Vakkennis:
Experience with industrial machinery, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.

- Talenkennis:
Good command of English is required.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL 

The Tribe Artificial Intelligence aims to deliver an efficient and seamless banking experience for our customers and empower our employees through AI. Our expert team of approximately 90 experts includes Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Product Owners and Managers. We are seeking a Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience in developing AI applications, including both generative and predictive AI. 

 

AND IN DETAIL 

• You develop AI applications to address various business challenges, including virtual assistants to enhance client experiences, advanced AI tools to support employee efficiency and creativity, and automation to optimize internal processes. 
• You use various analytical methods, including large language models (Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning), speech-to-text, agentic AI applications, image generation and interpretation, and classical statistical/machine learning techniques. While expertise in all areas is not required, strong proficiency in core technologies and the ability to learn new methods as needed are essential. 
• You contribute to deploying AI applications in production using a comprehensive stack of tools. 
• You access one of the richest volumes of varied data in the market and apply your skills to it. 
• You evolve in an environment where innovation and lean processes are praised, straight-forward communication is encouraged, and peers understand the meaning of team up. 
• You work with a team of colleagues in an Agile organization who are ready to collaborate and to share their experience. 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES 

• You hold at least a Master’s degree in a quantitative field like statistics, computer science or engineering, with a focus on natural language processing. A PhD is advantageous. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with strong analytics knowledge are also welcome. 
• You have a minimum of 3 years' experience in data science, preferably in the financial sector, though less experience may be accepted if your academic achievements are substantial. 
• You are fluent in English and have a good command of French and/or Dutch. 
• You are proficient in Python for model building and understand ML engineering fundamentals (e.g., versioning systems) to produce code ready for CI/CD integration.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
•  15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Responsibilities

• Own the system architecture for infrastructure platforms, including virtualization, cluster design, SAN/NAS, and DRP constructs.
• Define and maintain architectural principles, guardrails, and standards aligned with enterprise and assurance expectations.
• Develop the architectural runway to enable upcoming platform capabilities while managing technical debt and lifecycle constraints.
• Guide and challenge solution designs proposed by teams, vendors, and integrators to ensure consistency across environments.
• Lead architectural decisions regarding availability, resilience, performance, scalability, and security.
• Collaborate with stakeholders, including product management and security, to ensure architectures are operationally sound and auditable.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in system architecture focusing on IaaS compute and storage platforms.
• You bring professional expertise in storage and backup technologies such as NetApp, Cohesity, and Veritas NetBackup.
• You possess comprehensive knowledge of infrastructure components including virtualization, SAN/NAS, DRP, and High-Performance Computing (HPC).
• You have a deep understanding of Open Systems and infrastructure security.
• You're familiar with Agile methodologies and CI/CD pipelines.
• You have strong analytical mind and conceptual thinking skills.
• You are proactive and solution-oriented with strong stakeholder management abilities.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with large-scale datacenter renewal or automation initiatives.
• Knowledge of architectural governance forums and decision documentation.

jobs.occupation: Big Water Consulting - Senior Python Developer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Python Developer, you will be instrumental in architecting, developing, and maintaining resilient software solutions essential to Clients core business activities. You will work hand-in-hand with multidisciplinary teams to deliver reliable, high-performing applications while fostering the continuous enhancement of technical standards.

Your main assignment will center around the internal monitoring platform, which is dedicated to monitoring and maintaining application health. The internal monitoring facilitates the implementation and management of sophisticated synthetic and log checks for live applications, ensuring timely information about their operational status and coordinating SWIFT notification to relevant personnel whenever intervention is warranted.

At the heart the platform lie the monitoring and alerting engines, both developed in Python, alongside all associated monitoring scripts. Your skills and experience will be pivotal to the ongoing evolution and reliability of this solution.
Key responsibilities

• Collaborate actively to the development and optimization of Python-based software applications.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and define software specifications.

• Engage with customers to address service request and ensure effective resolution.

• Implement best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment (CI/CD).

• Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.

• Work with DevOps and data engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and performance.

• Ensure security, scalability, and maintainability of solutions.

Key stakeholders:

• Other software development teams

• Product Owners & Business Analysts

• Data Engineers & Architects

• IT Operations

• Business stakeholders

• IT/tech-related academic degree (bachelor's or master's degree.

• 6+ years of experience in Development.

• 3+ years of experience using Python.

• Strong understanding of IT security requirements and their implementation ideally in the context of critical infrastructure

• Proficiency in Python for backend services, preferably with FastAPI or similar frameworks.

• Proficiency with data validation lib as Pydantic.

• Experience with Asyncio.

• Experience in SQL.

• Experience with databases like MSSQL, PostgreSQL.

• Experience with RabbitMQ.

• Strong understanding of service-based architectures and event-driven systems

• Solid conceptual knowledge of software design patterns, scalability, and continuous integration practices

• Knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g Selenium)

• Solid understanding of software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to mentor and provide technical leadership.

• Experience working in agile environments.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Experience with Azure cloud is a plus.

• Experience in NoSQL solutions is a plus.

• Ability to work with legacy code and participate to refactoring initiative.

• Familiarity with containerization using Docker and deployment pipelines in a CI/CD environment is a plus.

• Good level of Dutch and/or French and English is required, German is a plus.

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
